runtimeEscalation.reason: This Skill validates interaction evidence and contracts; external behavior remains outside its claim.

caseAssertions.invalid-input: malformed or incomplete contract is rejected
caseAssertions.repeat-idempotency: repeated contract validation produces the same normalized hash
caseAssertions.hash-change-cache-invalidation: contract revision/hash is available for stale-plan detection
caseAssertions.interruption-recovery: partial contract declares a bounded recovery action
caseAssertions.deterministic-output: validator output is stable for the same contract

responsibilityScope: Task-scoped user-intent contracts and evidence-first interaction assessment; no implementation or runtime authority.

specializedAcceptance.title: interaction intent contract static gate
specializedAcceptance.runtimeBoundary: Static acceptance proves contract structure and deterministic replay only; it does not prove that an AI understood unobserved user intent or that Unity/editor behavior is correct.
